local scn, done = ...
local bot = player.GetBots()[1]
local rows, hurts, t = {}, {}, -30
hook.Add("PlayerHurt", "parity_drown", function(ply, att, hp, dmg) if ply == bot then hurts[#hurts+1] = { t = t, hp = hp, dmg = dmg } end end)
hook.Add("EntityTakeDamage", "parity_drown", function(ent, info) if ent == bot then hurts[#hurts+1] = { t = t, take = info:GetDamage(), type = info:GetDamageType() } end end)
hook.Add("PlayerDeath", "parity_drown", function(ply) if ply == bot then hurts[#hurts+1] = { t = t, death = true } end end)
hook.Add("StartCommand", "parity_drown", function(ply, cmd) if ply == bot then cmd:ClearButtons() cmd:ClearMovement() end end)
hook.Add("SetupMove", "parity_drown", function(ply, mv, cmd)
  if ply ~= bot then return end
  if t < 0 then mv:SetOrigin(Vector(0, 2600, -300)) mv:SetVelocity(Vector(0, 0, 0)) end
  if t >= 2400 and t < 2700 then mv:SetOrigin(Vector(0, 2600, -150)) mv:SetVelocity(Vector(0, 0, 0)) end
  if t >= 2700 then mv:SetOrigin(Vector(0, 2600, -300)) mv:SetVelocity(Vector(0, 0, 0)) end
end)
hook.Add("Think", "parity_drown", function()
  t = t + 1
  if t >= 0 and (t % 5 == 0) then
    rows[#rows+1] = { t = t, hp = bot:Health(), water = bot:WaterLevel(), z = bot:GetPos().z, alive = bot:Alive() }
  end
  if t == 4000 then
    for _, h in ipairs({ "Think", "PlayerHurt", "EntityTakeDamage", "PlayerDeath", "StartCommand", "SetupMove" }) do hook.Remove(h, "parity_drown") end
    done({ rows = rows, hurts = hurts })
  end
end)
return "async"
